source: kimi.e3_constants of kimi26-tp4-gb300-step-model.json (sha256 3ebd1b1b9d1e5c627febb43f6f1012fb26b8a652c9f200cdd06b0a589169d64f): Kimi-K2.6 TP4 GB300 step model fitted on NSC job 264995 (6P3D c128 CUA static baseline, P workers 0-5, fit window 300-1800 s); offline E3 with next-pass APE mean 13.5 %, p50 6.7 %, p95 36.8 % on its score window

new_tokens coefficient 0: full chunks make it collinear with the intercept
LAUNCH_Y_MAX_S = 5 s (E3 constant) drops launch intervals >= 5 s: share 0.102 of the fit-window Kimi intervals; raise it (e.g. 15 s) before any online launch refit on Kimi
G2 online GPU fit needs idle single-request passes; a saturated Kimi P has few (see idle counts): freeze these warmup constants instead of relying on the online G2 refit
